remarks: Step into timeless elegance with this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-full bath home that blends historic character with modern upgrades. Every inch of this residence has been thoughtfully updated during a comprehensive renovation just five years ago—including new flooring, light fixtures, furnace, central air conditioning, hot water tank, updated electric service, and the convenience of first-floor laundry. The heart of the home is the stunning, fully updated kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, granite countertops, a stylish tile backsplash, stainless steel appliances, a breakfast bar, and designer lighting—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Adjacent to the kitchen, the formal dining room includes a custom-built bar area complete with sink and beverage refrigerator. Enjoy architectural details such as multiple decorative fireplaces, exposed brick walls, tall ceilings, a curved staircase with large newel post, leaded glass windows, and original character throughout. The property also offers a charming side yard ideal for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. Bonus features include a full walk-up attic—ready to be finished for additional living space or used as generous storage. This one-of-a-kind home offers a rare combination of vintage charm and modern luxury.
